entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Where're we meeting today?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh right, we were never[n]told where to meet up.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: At the courthouse.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Where's that?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hint: the government[n]office district.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Kasumigaseki...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Indeed.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, I've heard of that place.[n]Never been there though.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Me neither.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's not somewhere normal[n]people usually go.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Whoa. Just looking at the[n]map is impressive.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The Police Department, Ministry[n]of Justice, Public Prosecutor's[n]Office, AND Public Security.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The Diet Building is[n]right near there too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!? What kinda scary[n]place are we going to!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We won't get caught, right...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: According to Akechi-kun,[n]our identities haven't[n]been discovered yet.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So we are just going to plunge[n]head-first into enemy territory...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Has anyone contacted Akechi?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We're going to meet him there.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Be on guard, everyone. We'll[n]be heading into a lion's den.
